==Overview==
A gonfalon is a [[Magic_items#Group_Magic_Items|group magic item]] that provides an advantage to a [[Bands#Banners|banner]]. They follow the same phys-rep rules as magic [[#Magic_items#Magic_Standards|magic standards]]. However a gonfalon is bonded to the entire band - rather than rather than an single individual like a magic standard.
